Alif Laam Raa. Yeh kitaab-e-mubeen ki aayatein hain
Hum ne ise Arabi Quran bana kar naazil kiya hai ke shaayad tum logon ko aql aa jaaye
Paighambar! Hum aap ke saamne ek behtareen qissa bayaan kar rahe hain jis ki wahi is Quran ke zariye aap ki taraf ki gayi hai, agarche is se pehle aap us ki taraf se bekhabar logon mein the
Us waqt ko yaad karo jab Yusuf ne apne waalid se kaha ke Baba! Main ne khwaab mein gyaarah sitaaron aur aaftaab o maahtaab ko dekha hai, aur yeh dekha hai ke yeh sab mere saamne sajda kar rahe hain
Ya'qoob ne kaha ke beta! Khabardaar apna khwaab apne bhaaiyon se bayaan na karna ke woh log ulti seedhi tadbeeron mein lag jaayenge, ke Shaitaan insaan ka bada khula hua dushman hai

Aur isi tarah tumhaara Parwardigar tumhein muntakhab karega aur tumhein baaton ki taaweel sikhaaega, aur tum par aur Ya'qoob ki doosri aulaad par apni ne'mat ko tamaam karega jis tarah tumhaare dada par-dada Ibraheem aur Is'haaq par tamaam kar chuka hai. Beshak tumhaara Parwardigar bada jaanne waala hai aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Yaqeenan Yusuf aur un ke bhaaiyon ke waaqe'a mein sawaal karne waalon ke liye badi nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Jab un logon ne kaha ke Yusuf aur un ke bhaai (Ibn-e-Yameen) hamaare baap ki nigaah mein ziyaada mehboob hain, haalaanke hamaari ek badi jamaa'at hai. Yaqeenan hamaare maa baap ek khuli hui gumraahi mein mubtala hain
Tum log Yusuf ko qatl kar do ya kisi zameen mein phenk do to baap ka rukh tumhaari hi taraf ho jaaega, aur tum sab us ke baad saaleh qaum ban jaaoge
Un mein se ek shakhs ne kaha ke Yusuf ko qatl na karo balke kisi andhe kuein mein daal do taake koi qaafila utha le jaaye, agar tum kuch karna hi chaahte ho
Un logon ne Ya'qoob se kaha ke Baba! Kya baat hai ke aap Yusuf ke baare mein hum par bharosa nahin karte hain, haalaanke hum un par shafqat karne waale hain
Kal hamaare saath bhej dijiye, kuch khaaye piye aur khele, aur hum to us ki hifaazat karne waale maujood hi hain
Ya'qoob ne kaha ke mujhe us ka le jaana takleef pahunchaata hai, aur main darta hoon ke kaheen use bhediya na kha jaaye aur tum ghaafil hi reh jaao
Aur un logon ne kaha ke agar use bhediya kha gaya aur hum sab us ke bhaai hi hain, to hum bade khasaare waalon mein ho jaayenge

Us ke baad jab woh sab Yusuf ko le gaye aur yeh tai kar liya ke inhein andhe kuein mein daal dein, aur hum ne Yusuf ki taraf wahi kar di ke anqareeb tum un ko is saazish se baakhabar karoge aur inhein khayaal bhi na hoga
Aur woh log raat ke waqt baap ke paas rote peet-te aaye

Kehne lage Baba! Hum daud lagaane chale gaye aur Yusuf ko apne saamaan ke paas chhod diya, to ek bhediya aa kar inhein kha gaya, aur aap hamaari baat ka yaqeen na karenge chaahe hum kitne hi sachche kyon na hon

Aur Yusuf ke kurte par jhoota khoon laga kar le aaye. Ya'qoob ne kaha ke yeh baat sirf tumhaare dil ne gadhi hai, lihaaza mera raasta sabr-e-jameel ka hai, aur Allah tumhaare bayaan ke muqaable mein mera madadgaar hai

Aur wahaan ek qaafila aaya jis ke paani nikaalne waale ne apna dol kuein mein daala, to aawaaz di: Are waah! Yeh to bachcha hai. Aur use ek qeemati sarmaaya samajh kar chhupa liya, aur Allah un ke aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai
Aur un logon ne Yusuf ko ma'mooli qeemat par bech daala, chand dirham ke ewaz, aur woh log to un se bezaar the hi

Aur Misr ke jis shakhs ne inhein khareeda tha us ne apni biwi se kaha ke ise izzat o ehteraam ke saath rakho, shaayad yeh humein koi faaida pahunchaaye ya hum ise apna farzand bana lein. Aur is tarah hum ne Yusuf ko zameen mein iqtidaar diya, aur taake is tarah inhein khwaabon ki ta'beer ka ilm sikhaayein, aur Allah apne kaam par ghalaba rakhne waala hai, yeh aur baat hai ke aksar logon ko is ka ilm nahin hai
Aur jab Yusuf apni jawaani ki umr ko pahunche to hum ne inhein hukm aur ilm ata kar diya, ke hum isi tarah nek amal karne waalon ko jaza diya karte hain

Aur us ne un se izhaar-e-mohabbat kiya jis ke ghar mein Yusuf rehte the, aur darwaaze band kar diye aur kehne lagi: Lo aao! Yusuf ne kaha ke Ma'aazallah! Woh mera maalik hai, us ne mujhe achchhi tarah rakha hai, aur zulm karne waale kabhi kaamyaab nahin hote

Aur yaqeenan us aurat ne un se buraai ka iraada kiya, aur woh bhi iraada kar baith-te agar apne Rab ki daleel na dekh lete. Yeh to hum ne is tarah ka intizaam kiya ke un se buraai aur badkaari ka rukh mod dein, ke woh hamaare mukhlis bandon mein se the

Aur donon ne darwaaze ki taraf sabqat ki aur us ne un ka kurta peechhe se phaad diya, aur donon ne us ke sardaar ko darwaaze hi par dekh liya. Us ne ghabra kar faryaad ki ke jo tumhaari aurat ke saath buraai ka iraada kare us ki saza is ke ilaawa kya hai ke use qaidi bana diya jaaye ya us par dardnaak azaab kiya jaaye

Yusuf ne kaha ke us ne khud mujh se izhaar-e-mohabbat kiya hai, aur is par us ke ghar waalon mein se ek gawaah ne gawaahi bhi de di ke agar un ka daaman saamne se phata hai to woh sachchi hai aur yeh jhooton mein se hain
Aur agar un ka kurta peechhe se phata hai to woh jhooti hai aur yeh sachchon mein se hain
Phir jo dekha ke un ka kurta peechhe se phata hai to us ne kaha ke yeh tum auraton ki makkaari hai, tumhaara makr bahut azeem hota hai
Yusuf! Ab tum is se e'raaz karo, aur Zulaikha! Tu apne gunaah ke liye istighfaar kar ke tu khata-kaaron mein hai

Aur phir shehar ki auraton ne kehna shuroo kar diya ke Azeez-e-Misr ki aurat apne jawaan ko apni taraf kheench rahi thi aur use us ki mohabbat ne madhosh bana diya tha. Hum yeh dekh rahe hain ke yeh aurat bilkul hi khuli hui gumraahi mein hai

Phir jab Zulaikha ne un auraton ki makkaari aur tash-heer ka haal suna to bula bheja aur un ke liye pur-takalluf daawat ka intizaam kar ke masnad laga di, aur sab ko ek ek chhuri de di, aur Yusuf se kaha ke tum un ke saamne se nikal jaao. Phir jaise hi un logon ne dekha to bada haseen o jameel paaya aur apne haath kaat daale aur kaha ke Maasha'Allah! Yeh to aadmi nahin hai balke koi mohtaram farishta hai

Zulaikha ne kaha ke yahi woh hai jis ke baare mein tum logon ne meri malaamat ki hai, aur main ne ise kheenchna chaaha tha ke yeh bach kar nikal gaya, aur jab meri baat nahin maani to ab qaid kiya jaaega aur zaleel bhi hoga

Yusuf ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Yeh qaid mujhe us kaam se ziyaada mehboob hai jis ki taraf yeh log daawat de rahi hain, aur agar tu un ke makr ko meri taraf se mod na dega to main un ki taraf maail ho sakta hoon aur mera shumaar bhi jaahilon mein ho sakta hai
To un ke Parwardigar ne un ki baat qubool kar li aur un auraton ke makr ko pher diya, ke woh sab ki sunne waala aur sab ka jaanne waala hai
Us ke baad un logon ko tamaam nishaaniyaan dekhne ke baad bhi yeh khayaal aa gaya ke kuch muddat ke liye Yusuf ko qaidi bana dein

Aur qaid-khaane mein un ke saath do jawaan aur daakhil hue. Ek ne kaha ke main ne khwaab mein apne ko sharaab nichodte dekha hai, aur doosre ne kaha main ne dekha hai ke main apne sar par rotiyaan laade hoon aur parinde us mein se kha rahe hain. Zara is ki taaweel to batao ke hamaari nazar mein tum nek-kirdaar maaloom hote ho

Yusuf ne kaha ke jo khaana tum ko diya jaata hai woh na aane paaega aur main tumhein ta'beer bata doonga. Yeh ta'beer mujhe mere Parwardigar ne bataayi hai, aur main ne us qaum ke raaste ko chhod diya hai jis ka imaan Allah par nahin hai aur woh roz-e-aakhirat ka bhi inkaar karne waali hai

Main apne baap daada Ibraheem, Is'haaq aur Ya'qoob ke tareeqe ka pairau hoon. Mere liye mumkin nahin hai ke main kisi cheez ko bhi Khuda ka shareek banaaoon. Yeh to mere oopar aur tamaam insaanon par Khuda ka fazl o karam hai, lekin insaanon ki aksariyat shukr-e-Khuda nahin karti hai
Mere qaid-khaane ke saathiyo! Zara yeh to batao ke mutafarriq qism ke khuda behtar hote hain ya ek Khuda-e-Waahid o Qahhaar

Tum us Khuda ko chhod kar sirf un naamon ki parastish karte ho jinhein tum ne khud rakh liya hai ya tumhaare aaba o ajdaad ne. Allah ne un ke baare mein koi daleel naazil nahin ki hai, jab ke hukm karne ka haq sirf Khuda ko hai, aur usi ne hukm diya hai ke us ke ilaawa kisi ki ibaadat na ki jaaye, ke yahi mustahkam aur seedha deen hai, lekin aksar log is baat ko nahin jaante hain

Mere qaid-khaane ke saathiyo! Tum mein se ek apne maalik ko sharaab pilaaega, aur doosra sooli par latka diya jaaega aur parinde us ke sar se noch noch kar khaayenge. Yeh us baat ke baare mein faisla ho chuka hai jis ke baare mein tum sawaal kar rahe ho

Aur phir jis ke baare mein khayaal tha ke woh najaat paane waala hai us se kaha ke zara apne maalik se mera bhi zikr kar dena, lekin Shaitaan ne use maalik se zikr karne ko bhula diya aur Yusuf chand saal tak qaid-khaane hi mein pade rahe

Aur phir ek din baadshaah ne logon se kaha ke main ne khwaab mein saat moti gaayein dekhi hain jinhein saat patli gaayein khaaye ja rahi hain, aur saat hari taazi baaliyaan dekhi hain aur saat khushk baaliyaan dekhi hain. Tum sab mere khwaab ke baare mein raaye do agar tumhein khwaab ki ta'beer dena aata ho to
Un logon ne kaha ke yeh to ek khwaab-e-pareshaan hai, aur hum aise khwaabon ki taaweel se baakhabar nahin hain
Aur phir donon qaidiyon mein se jo bach gaya tha aur jise ek muddat ke baad Yusuf ka paighaam yaad aaya, us ne kaha ke main tumhein is ki ta'beer se baakhabar karta hoon, lekin zara mujhe bhej to do

Yusuf! Ae mard-e-siddeeq! Zara un saat moti gaayon ke baare mein jinhein saat dubli gaayein kha rahi hain, aur saat hari baaliyon aur saat khushk baaliyon ke baare mein apni raaye to batao, shaayad main logon ke paas baakhabar waapas jaaoon to shaayad inhein bhi ilm ho jaaye
Yusuf ne kaha ke tum log saat baras tak musalsal zara'at karoge, to jo ghalla paida ho use baaliyon samet rakh dena, ilaawa thodi miqdaar ke jo tumhaare khaane ke kaam mein aaye
Us ke baad saat sakht saal aayenge jo tumhaare saare zakheere ko kha jaayenge, ilaawa us thode maal ke jo tum ne bacha kar rakha hai
Us ke baad ek saal aaega jis mein logon ki faryaad-rasi aur baarish hogi aur log khoob angoor nichodenge

To baadshaah ne yeh sun kar kaha ke zara use yahaan to le aao. Pas jab numaainda aaya to Yusuf ne kaha ke apne maalik ke paas palat kar jaao aur poochho ke un auraton ke baare mein kya khayaal hai jinhon ne apne haath kaat daale the, ke mera Parwardigar un ke makr se khoob baakhabar hai

Baadshaah ne un auraton se daryaaft kiya ke aakhir tumhaara kya mu'aamala tha jab tum ne Yusuf se izhaar-e-ta'alluq kiya tha? Un logon ne kaha ke Maasha'Allah! Hum ne hargiz un mein koi buraai nahin dekhi. To Azeez-e-Misr ki biwi ne kaha ke ab haq bilkul waazeh ho gaya hai ke main ne khud inhein apni taraf maail karne ki koshish ki thi aur woh saadiqeen mein se hain

Yusuf ne kaha ke yeh saari baat is liye hai ke baadshaah ko yeh maaloom ho jaaye ke main ne us ki adam-maujoodgi mein koi khiyaanat nahin ki hai, aur Khuda khiyaanat-kaaron ke makr ko kaamyaab nahin hone deta
Aur main apne nafs ko bhi bari nahin qaraar deta, ke nafs bahar-haal buraaiyon ka hukm dene waala hai, magar yeh ke mera Parwardigar reham kare, ke woh bada bakhshne waala meharbaan hai
Aur baadshaah ne kaha ke zara inhein le aao, main apne zaati umoor mein saath rakhoonga. Us ke baad jab un se baat ki to kaha ke tum aaj se hamaare darbaar mein ba-waqaar ameen ki haisiyat se rahoge
Yusuf ne kaha ke mujhe zameen ke khazaanon par muqarrar kar do ke main muhaafiz bhi hoon aur saahib-e-ilm bhi

Aur is tarah hum ne Yusuf ko zameen mein ikhtiyaar de diya ke woh jahaan chaahein rahein. Hum apni rehmat se jis ko bhi chaahte hain martaba de dete hain aur kisi nek-kirdaar ke ajr ko zaaya nahin karte
Aur aakhirat ka ajr to un logon ke liye behtareen hai jo saahibaan-e-imaan hain aur Khuda se darne waale hain
Aur jab Yusuf ke bhaai Misr aaye aur Yusuf ke paas pahunche to unhon ne sab ko pehchaan liya aur woh log nahin pehchaan sake

Phir jab un ka saamaan taiyaar kar diya to un se kaha ke tumhaara ek bhaai aur bhi hai, use bhi le aao. Kya tum nahin dekhte ho ke main saamaan ki naap tol bhi baraabar rakhta hoon aur mehmaan-nawaazi bhi karne waala hoon
Ab agar use na le aaye to aainda tumhein bhi ghalla na doonga aur na mere paas aane paaoge
Un logon ne kaha ke hum us ke baap se baat cheet karenge aur zaroor karenge
Aur Yusuf ne apne jawaanon se kaha ke un ki poonji bhi un ke saamaan mein rakh do, shaayad jab ghar palat kar jaayein to use pehchaan lein, aur is tarah shaayad dobaara palat kar zaroor aayein

Ab jo palat kar baap ki khidmat mein aaye aur kaha ke Baba jaan! Aainda humein ghalle se rok diya gaya hai, lihaaza hamaare saath hamaare bhaai ko bhi bhej dijiye taake hum ghalla haasil kar lein, aur ab hum us ki hifaazat ke zimmedaar hain

Ya'qoob ne kaha ke hum us ke baare mein tumhaare oopar isi tarah bharosa karein jis tarah pehle us ke bhaai Yusuf ke baare mein kiya tha? Khair, Khuda behtareen hifaazat karne waala hai aur wahi sab se ziyaada reham karne waala hai

Phir jab un logon ne apna saamaan khola to dekha ke un ki bizaa'at (qeemat) waapas kar di gayi hai. To kehne lage Baba jaan! Ab hum kya chaahte hain? Yeh hamaari poonji bhi waapas kar di gayi hai. Ab hum apne ghar waalon ke liye ghalla zaroor laayenge aur apne bhaai ki hifaazat bhi karenge aur ek oont ka baar aur badhwa lenge, ke yeh baat us ki maujoodgi mein aasaan hai

Ya'qoob ne kaha ke main use hargiz tumhaare saath na bhejoonga jab tak ke Khuda ki taraf se ahd na karoge ke use waapas zaroor laaoge, magar yeh ke tum hi ko gher liya jaaye. Us ke baad jab un logon ne ahd kar liya to Ya'qoob ne kaha ke Allah hum logon ke qaul o qaraar ka nigraan aur zaamin hai

Aur phir kaha ke mere farzando! Dekho sab ek darwaaze se daakhil na hona aur mutafarriq darwaazon se daakhil hona, ke main Khuda ki taraf se aane waali balaaon mein tumhaare kaam nahin aa sakta. Hukm sirf Allah ke haath mein hai, aur usi par mera e'temaad hai, aur usi par saare tawakkul karne waalon ko bharosa karna chaahiye

Aur jab woh log isi tarah daakhil hue jis tarah un ke waalid ne kaha tha, agarche woh Khudaai bala ko taal nahin sakte the, lekin yeh ek khwaahish thi jo Ya'qoob ke dil mein paida hui jise unhon ne poora kar liya, aur woh hamaare diye hue ilm ki bina par saahib-e-ilm bhi the, agarche aksar log is haqeeqat se bhi naawaaqif hain

Aur jab woh log Yusuf ke saamne haazir hue to unhon ne apne bhaai ko apne paas panaah di aur kaha ke main tumhaara bhaai Yusuf hoon, lihaaza jo bartaao yeh log karte rahe hain ab us ki taraf se ranj na karna
Us ke baad jab Yusuf ne un ka saamaan taiyaar kara diya to pyaale ko apne bhaai ke saamaan mein rakhwa diya. Us ke baad munaadi ne aawaaz di ke qaafile waalo! Tum sab chor ho
Un logon ne mud kar dekha aur kaha ke aakhir tumhaari kya cheez gum ho gayi hai
Mulaazimeen ne kaha ke baadshaah ka pyaala nahin mil raha hai, aur jo use le kar aaega use ek oont ka baar ghalla in'aam milega, aur main us ka zimmedaar hoon
Un logon ne kaha ke Khuda ki qasam tumhein to maaloom hai ke hum zameen mein fasaad karne ke liye nahin aaye hain aur na hum chor hain
Mulaazimon ne kaha ke agar tum jhoote saabit hue to us ki saza kya hai
Un logon ne kaha ke us ki saza khud woh shakhs hai jis ke saamaan mein se pyaala baraamad ho, hum isi tarah zulm karne waalon ko saza dete hain

Us ke baad bhaai ke saamaan se pehle doosre bhaaiyon ke saamaan ki talaashi li aur aakhir mein bhaai ke saamaan mein se pyaala nikaal liya. Aur is tarah hum ne Yusuf ke haq mein tadbeer ki, ke woh baadshaah ke qaanoon se apne bhaai ko nahin le sakte the magar yeh ke Khuda khud chaahe. Hum jis ko chaahte hain us ke darajaat ko buland kar dete hain, aur har saahib-e-ilm se bartar ek saahib-e-ilm hota hai

Un logon ne kaha ke agar is ne chori ki hai to kya ta'ajjub hai, is ka bhaai is se pehle chori kar chuka hai. Yusuf ne is baat ko apne dil mein chhupa liya aur un par izhaar nahin kiya. Kaha ke tum bade bure log ho, aur Allah tumhaare bayaanaat ke baare mein ziyaada behtar jaanne waala hai

Un logon ne kaha ke ae Azeez-e-Misr! Is ke waalid bahut za'eef-ul-umr hain, lihaaza hum mein se kisi ek ko is ki jagah par le lijiye aur ise chhod dijiye, ke hum aap ko ehsaan karne waala samajhte hain
Yusuf ne kaha ke Khuda ki panaah ke hum jis ke paas apna saamaan paayein us ke ilaawa kisi doosre ko giraft mein le lein aur is tarah zaalim ho jaayein

Ab jab woh log Yusuf ki taraf se maayoos ho gaye to alag ja kar mashwara karne lage. To sab se bade ne kaha ke kya tumhein nahin maaloom ke tumhaare baap ne tum se Khudaai ahd liya hai, aur is se pehle bhi tum Yusuf ke baare mein kotaahi kar chuke ho? To ab main to is sarzameen ko na chhodoonga yahaan tak ke waalid-e-mohtaram ijaazat de dein ya Khuda mere haq mein koi faisla kar de, ke woh behtareen faisla karne waala hai
Haan tum log baap ki khidmat mein jaao aur arz karo ke aap ke farzand ne chori ki hai, aur hum usi baat ki gawaahi de rahe hain jis ka humein ilm hai, aur hum ghaib ki hifaazat karne waale nahin hain
Aap us basti se daryaaft kar lein jis mein hum the aur us qaafile se poochh lein jis mein hum aaye hain, aur hum bilkul sachche hain

Ya'qoob ne kaha ke yeh tumhaare dil ne ek nayi baat gadh li hai. Main phir bhi sabr-e-jameel ikhtiyaar karoonga, ke shaayad Khuda un sab ko le aaye, ke woh har shai ka jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Yeh keh kar unhon ne sab se munh pher liya aur kaha ke afsos hai Yusuf ke haal par, aur itna roye ke aankhein safed ho gayin aur gham ke ghoont peete rahe
Un logon ne kaha ke aap isi tarah Yusuf ko yaad karte rahenge yahaan tak ke beemaar ho jaayein ya halaak hone waalon mein shaamil ho jaayein
Ya'qoob ne kaha ke main apne huzn o gham aur apni beqaraari ki faryaad Allah ki baargaah mein kar raha hoon, aur us ki taraf se woh sab jaanta hoon jo tum nahin jaante ho
Mere farzando! Jaao Yusuf aur un ke bhaai ko khoob talaash karo aur rehmat-e-Khuda se maayoos na hona, ke us ki rehmat se kaafir qaum ke ilaawa koi maayoos nahin hota hai

Ab jo woh log dobaara Yusuf ke paas gaye to kehne lage ke ae Azeez! Hum ko aur hamaare ghar waalon ko badi takleef hai, aur hum ek haqeer si poonji le kar aaye hain. Aap humein poora poora ghalla de dein aur hum par ehsaan karein, ke Khuda khair karne waalon ko jazaa-e-khair deta hai
Us ne kaha ke tumhein maaloom hai ke tum ne Yusuf aur un ke bhaai ke saath kya bartaao kiya hai jab ke tum bilkul jaahil the

Un logon ne kaha ke kya aap hi Yusuf hain? Unhon ne kaha ke beshak main Yusuf hoon aur yeh mera bhaai hai. Allah ne hamaare oopar ehsaan kiya hai, aur jo koi bhi taqwa aur sabr ikhtiyaar karta hai, Allah nek amal karne waalon ke ajr ko zaaya nahin karta hai
Un logon ne kaha ke Khuda ki qasam Khuda ne aap ko fazeelat aur imtiyaaz ata kiya hai aur hum sab khata-kaar the
Yusuf ne kaha ke aaj tumhaare oopar koi ilzaam nahin hai. Khuda tumhein maaf kar dega ke woh bada reham karne waala hai
Jaao meri qameez le kar jaao aur Baba ke chehre par daal do ke un ki basaarat palat aaegi, aur is martaba apne tamaam ghar waalon ko saath le kar aana
Ab jo qaafila Misr se rawaana hua to un ke padar-e-buzurgwaar ne kaha ke main Yusuf ki khushboo mehsoos kar raha hoon, agar tum log mujhe sathiyaaya hua na kaho
Un logon ne kaha ke Khuda ki qasam aap abhi tak apni puraani gumraahi mein mubtala hain

Us ke baad jab basheer ne aa kar qameez ko Ya'qoob ke chehre par daal diya to dobaara saahib-e-basaarat ho gaye, aur unhon ne kaha ke main ne tum se na kaha tha ke main Khuda ki taraf se woh jaanta hoon jo tum nahin jaante ho
Un logon ne kaha Baba jaan! Ab aap hamaare gunaahon ke liye istighfaar karein, hum yaqeenan khata-kaar the
Unhon ne kaha ke main anqareeb tumhaare haq mein istighfaar karoonga, ke mera Parwardigar bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Us ke baad jab woh log sab Yusuf ke yahaan haazir hue to unhon ne maa baap ko apne pehlu mein jagah di aur kaha ke aap log Misr mein Insha'Allah bade itminaan o sukoon ke saath daakhil hon

Aur unhon ne waalidain ko buland maqaam par takht par jagah di, aur sab log Yusuf ke saamne sajde mein gir pade. Yusuf ne kaha ke Baba! Yeh mere pehle khwaab ki ta'beer hai jise mere Parwardigar ne sach kar dikhaaya hai, aur us ne mere saath ehsaan kiya hai ke mujhe qaid-khaane se nikaal liya aur aap logon ko gaaon se nikaal kar Misr mein le aaya, jab ke Shaitaan mere aur mere bhaaiyon ke darmiyaan fasaad paida kar chuka tha. Beshak mera Parwardigar apne iraadon ki behtareen tadbeer karne waala aur saahib-e-ilm aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Parwardigar! Tu ne mujhe mulk bhi ata kiya aur khwaabon ki ta'beer ka ilm bhi diya. Tu zameen o aasmaan ka paida karne waala hai aur duniya o aakhirat mein mera waali aur sarparast hai. Mujhe duniya se farmaanbardaar uthaana aur saaliheen se mulhaq kar dena

Paighambar! Yeh sab ghaib ki khabrein hain jinhein hum wahi ke zariye aap tak pahuncha rahe hain, warna aap to us waqt na the jab woh log apne kaam par ittifaaq kar rahe the aur Yusuf ke baare mein buri tadbeerein kar rahe the
Aur aap kis qadr kyon na chaahein, insaanon ki aksariyat imaan laane waali nahin hai
Aur aap un se tableegh-e-risaalat ki ujrat to nahin maangte hain, yeh Quran to aalameen ke liye ek zikr aur naseehat hai
Aur zameen o aasmaan mein bahut si nishaaniyaan hain jin se log guzar jaate hain aur kinaara-kash hi rehte hain
Aur un mein ki aksariyat Khuda par imaan bhi laati hai to shirk ke saath
To kya yeh log is baat ki taraf se mutma'in ho gaye hain ke kaheen un par azaab-e-Ilaahi aa kar chha jaaye ya achaanak qiyaamat aa jaaye aur yeh ghaafil hi reh jaayein

Aap keh dijiye ke yahi mera raasta hai ke main baseerat ke saath Khuda ki taraf daawat deta hoon aur mere saath mera ittibaa' karne waala bhi hai, aur Khuda paak o be-niyaaz hai aur main mushrikeen mein se nahin hoon

Aur hum ne aap se pehle unhi mardon ko rasool banaaya hai jo aabaadiyon mein rehne waale the, aur hum ne un ki taraf wahi bhi ki hai. To kya yeh log zameen mein sair nahin karte ke dekhein ke un se pehle waalon ka anjaam kya hua hai? Aur daar-e-aakhirat sirf saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye behtareen manzil hai. Kya tum log aql se kaam nahin lete ho

Yahaan tak ke jab un ke inkaar se mursaleen maayoos hone lage aur un logon ne samajh liya ke un se jhoota wa'da kiya gaya hai, to hamaari madad mursaleen ke paas aa gayi aur hum ne jin logon ko chaaha inhein najaat de di, aur hamaara azaab mujrim qaum se paltaaya nahin ja sakta hai

Yaqeenan un ke waaqe'aat mein saahibaan-e-aql ke liye saamaan-e-ibrat hai, aur yeh koi aisi baat nahin hai jise gadh liya jaaye. Yeh Quran pehle ki tamaam kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne waala hai, aur is mein har shai ki tafseel hai, aur yeh saahib-e-imaan qaum ke liye hidaayat aur rehmat bhi hai
